# Serendip Studio

> > Educational platform exploring neuroscience, consciousness, and brain-behavior relationships through interactive demonstrations and scholarly research.

Serendip Studio is an educational initiative primarily associated with Bryn Mawr College, featuring work by Paul Grobstein and collaborators. The site offers interactive experiments, neuroanatomy resources, and interdisciplinary explorations connecting neuroscience with art, philosophy, and behavior.

## Key Topics

- Neuroscience
- Consciousness
- Brain-behavior relationships
- Visual perception
- Paul Grobstein
- Bryn Mawr College
- Behavioral variability
- Comparative neuroanatomy
- Educational demonstrations
- Free will
- Blindsight
- Pheromones
- Brain function
- Animal behavior
- Interactive learning

## Core Resources

- [Brain and Behavior](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/bbindex.html): Main index for Serendip's brain and behavior educational resources

## Interactive Demonstrations

- [Seeing what you don't see?](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/blindsight2.html): Interactive demo on blindsight and unconscious visual processing
- [Free will?](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/freewill3.html): Interactive experiment exploring free will and perception by Laura Cody
- [Blind Spots](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/blindspot4.html): Interactive demonstration of visual blind spots and brain function
- [Natural Ambiguities](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/ambigfig/Ambigrock.html): Visual perception demo of hills-valleys optical illusion
- [Serendip Plays Hide and Seek](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/hideseek.html): Interactive game exploring search strategy and serendipity

## Neuroscience and Consciousness

- [Variability in Brain Function and Behavior](http://serendipstudio.org/EncyHumBehav.html): Grobstein's encyclopedia entry on behavioral variability and brain function
- [Brain, art, transcendence](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/artneuro/transcendence.html): Grobstein explores consciousness, art, and brain's I-function
- [Neurons and Intelligence](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/kinser/Int9.html): Comparative neuroanatomy guide by Kinser & Grobstein on brain intelligence

## Student Research: The Nature of Desire

- [The "Nature" of Desire](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/berman/default.htm): Berman's senior research on neuroscience of desire at Bryn Mawr College
- [Part 1: Section 3: Pheromones in Humans: Menstrual Cycle Synchronization](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/berman/P1S3.htm): McClintock effect and human pheromone research on menstrual synchrony
- [Part 6: Section 2: The transcendence of the brain and the Ambiguity of the Human Experience](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/berman/P6S2.htm): Berman on brain transcendence and evolutionary psychology of love
- [The "Nature" of Desire (Original Index)](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/berman/indexorig.html): Berman's original index on desire integrating art and neuroscience

## Reference Materials

- [Diencephalon Definiton](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/kinser/definitions/def-diencephalon.html): Neuroanatomy definition of diencephalon and brain structures
- [Variability in Brain Function and Behavior: Figure 3](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/figure3.html): Grobstein & Oristaglio's frog behavioral variability research figure
- [Science -- Saunders et al. 286 (5440): 760](http://serendipstudio.org/bb/brainevolution/Saunders.html): Paleozoic ammonoid evolution and mass extinction research article
